# Waiting time in the borrowing queue

The tool cupboard queue is now mostly people asking whether a tool is safe to borrow. The sign-out tray solved a key problem, not a confidence problem. Added a tray for uncertain items and promised a response by the next shift. [[Volunteer handbook]] needs a visible pending state so a question does not look as though it has disappeared.
